high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from The Economic Times App, as indicated by the app icon and download count at the top. The article discusses Plutus, a platform founded in June 2021 by Karata Dasmahapatra, Shivanshu Tyagi, and Sambhav Jain. The platform facilitates interactions between content creators and their fans through live and casual community games. Key details from the text: Founded in June 2021. Features include live rooms, group chats, creator-led games, integrated payments, and analytics. Operates on a pay-as-you-go model
